title: 10/10 full of excitement and history.
text:
Excellent mastery of Barcelona’s history through verbal explanation and illustrations of verifiable references.
It was an excellent selection on our visit to Catalonia. We learned and had fun my wife and I for 3.5 hours. Recommended 10/10.
author: Angel_R

title: Good times!
text: We've done Segway tours before, but never had this much fun! Alex was an excellent guide, knowledgable with a sense of humor. Barcelona, with it's extensive network of bike paths, was a pleasure to tour.
author: Jesse4858

title: Great experience
text: It was the first time i ve touched a segway but i was way easier than i expected. Our guide was very clever, nice and informative
author: LokiOdinsson
